verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of design input is that Cloud Agents API prompts accept text plus up to 5 images. Separately, agents can build the app, start dev servers, open it in a browser and verify UI flows, and MCP servers can return images such as diagrams. Together these imply image-to-app is possible, but no documented design-to-app workflow exists. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of generating an app from a sketch or image design, any PDF design ingestion, image input in the IDE or chat (evidenced only via API), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
